page.title: Evaluation cycle
page.description: Open the performance evaluation cycle, move it through its stages and close it; the dates of the stages, the evaluation file and the extra-component catalog.
page.loadFailed: The evaluation cycle could not be loaded.
page.notReady: The cycle cannot open before the evaluation file is uploaded: the template of each of the five stages, the grade scale and the fiscal-year card.

actions.advance: Move the cycle to the next stage
actions.failed: The action failed: the stage of the cycle may have changed. Reload the page.

none.title: Not opened
none.what: HR uploads the evaluation file, prepares the catalog and the dates, then opens the cycle.

self.title: Self-evaluation
self.what: Rates their behaviours, writes their achievements and picks from the catalog; the manager is told when it is sent.

mgr.title: Manager's evaluation
mgr.who: The direct manager, then the one above
mgr.what: Reviews the self-evaluation and enters the results and behaviour scores.

cal.title: Calibration
cal.who: The holder of the calibration key
cal.what: Compares the managers and adjusts, with a written reason.

appr.title: Approval
appr.who: The holder of the approval key
appr.what: Approves the results and decides the objections.

notif.title: Individual notification
notif.what: Tells each employee their result individually, with an exportable copy.

closed.title: Closed
closed.what: The cycle is closed and the results stay in each employee's record.

open.title: Open the evaluation cycle
open.description: The cycle opens for a fiscal year and starts at the self-evaluation stage.
open.yearInvalid: Enter a year of four digits.
open.snapshot: The cycle takes a snapshot of the templates when it opens: what is uploaded afterwards does not change this year.
open.yearExists: A cycle for this year exists already.
open.failed: The cycle could not be opened.

advance.title: Move the cycle to the next stage
advance.description: The cycle moves to the next stage and does not go back.
advance.done: The cycle moved to the next stage.

closeCycle.title: Close the cycle
closeCycle.description: After closing, the evaluations cannot change and the results stay in each employee's record. Your name and the time are kept.

dates.title: Dates of the stages
dates.toHint: Optional: a single day when empty.
dates.failed: The date could not be saved.

keys.final: Final result after the numbers close
keys.notification: Individual notification with an exportable copy
keys.objection: Objection window (five working days from the notification)
keys.qualitative_close: Close of the qualitative part (behaviour and evidence)

problems.end_before_start: The end is before the start.
problems.before_previous: It starts before the stage ahead of it ends.
problems.after_next: It ends after the stage behind it starts.
problems.unknown: The date does not fit the other dates.

catalog.title: Extra-component catalog
catalog.empty: The catalog has no items yet.
catalog.noMatches: No item matches the search and filters.
catalog.addHint: An item the employee picks in their self-evaluation and the manager confirms.
catalog.removeTitle: Delete an item from the catalog
catalog.failed: The item could not be added.
catalog.titleShort: The name needs at least {{min}} characters.
catalog.removeFailed: The item could not be deleted.

file.title: Upload the evaluation file
file.description: One file for the five stages, then the grade scale and the fiscal-year card. Nothing is saved before you review it.
file.hint: txt, docx or pdf, read in the browser
file.paste: Or paste the text of the file
file.checkFailed: The file could not be checked.
file.empty: The text holds no stage, grade scale or fiscal card.
file.saveRefused: The file has parts that need review and was not saved.
file.saveFailed: The file could not be saved.

readErrors.unsupported: The file type is not supported.
readErrors.unreadable: The file could not be read.

problems.basic_split: Results + behaviour do not make the basic total.
problems.criteria_sum: The shares of the results criteria do not add up to 100.
problems.cap_sum: Basic + extra do not make the cap.
problems.behaviour_question: A behaviour has no question for the evaluator.
problems.duplicate_stage: The stage appears twice in the file.
problems.scale_levels: The grade scale does not have five levels.
problems.scale_range: A range of the grade scale is not understood.
problems.fiscal_months: The fiscal-year card does not have twelve months.
problems.stage_range: The stage number is outside 1 to 5.

performance-cycle.title: Evaluation cycle
performance-cycle.body: HR opens the performance evaluation cycle here, moves it through its stages and closes it, uploads the evaluation file and sets the dates and the catalog.

can.manage: Open the cycle, move it on and change the dates

evaluation.loadFailed: The performance evaluation could not be loaded.
evaluation.noCycle: The evaluation cycle has not been opened yet. When HR opens it, the button «start the self-evaluation» appears here and you get a message.
evaluation.none: You have no evaluation in this cycle
evaluation.noneHint: The evaluation of your title's stage is not uploaded yet, or you hold no title. HR will get in touch if needed.
evaluation.yourStage: Your evaluation is the evaluation of your stage
evaluation.yourStageHint: The weights, criteria, behaviours and grade scale are below.
evaluation.cap: The most the final score can be: {{cap}} (the cap).
evaluation.criteriaHint: Each criterion is a share of the results part (they add up to 100%).
evaluation.question: The evaluator's question
evaluation.scale: Grade scale (the final score out of {{cap}})
evaluation.scaleLabel: The grade scale from the lowest to the highest
evaluation.scaleDirection: Each level is higher than the one before it.

self.noteShort: A note is required at this level (at least {{min}} characters).
self.intro: You rate the behaviours on the same scale as your manager, write your achievements for each results criterion and pick from the catalog. Your manager sees it before their evaluation and is not bound by it.
self.introSent: You sent it, and you can change it until your manager starts.
self.achievementsTitle: My achievements for each results criterion (no score)
self.achievementHint: Write what you achieved and the evidence
self.learningCard: Calculated from the learning plan: {{done}} approved hours of {{of}}.
self.noItems: There are no items in this year's catalog.
self.failed: The self-evaluation could not be saved: check the fields or try again.

none.title: The evaluation cycle is open: rate yourself
none.body: Last day: {{date}}. You rate your behaviours and write your achievements, then your direct manager is told.

draft.title: You have a draft that was not sent
draft.body: Last day: {{date}}. Finish the evaluation and send it.

sent.title: You sent your self-evaluation
sent.body: Your manager {{manager}} was told and reviews it, then it goes to the manager above. You can change it until your manager starts.

self.noScores: Scores are not shown before the individual notification after the approval.
self.managerStage: The manager's stage: you can change your evaluation until your manager starts.
